svg.title: Container diagram: Wishem
svg.desc: Wishem has sixteen containers. The workbench process runs the host-nodejs package and uses the core package. The host-nodejs and core packages build on the hub package, and so does the page. The page and the workbench process build on the renderer-react package. The clock package builds on the hub package. The PixiJS process serves the link with the host-nodejs package and builds on the clock, core, and hub packages. The PixiJS page builds on the renderer-pixi, hub, and clock packages. The PixiJS page gets page code over HTTP and connects to the hub over a WebSocket link through the PixiJS process. The workbench process reads, watches, and writes the model folder and the product model folder. The page gets page code over HTTP and connects to the hub over a WebSocket link through the process. The Godot process serves the link with the host-nodejs package and builds on the clock, core, and hub packages. The Godot runner starts the Godot application in Docker and carries the link of the application over TCP to the Godot process. The Godot application connects to the hub over a WebSocket link through the Godot runner. The sample-product package has no relationship in the diagram. The designer starts the three processes and the Godot runner, edits the two folders, and looks at the two pages.
